scope: Exploratory synthetic comparison with shared constitutive physics. Reference completion and subsequent thermal outcomes are censored after equipment capacity exceedance. These are not plant measurements or plant validation.

dataset_protocol.scope: exploratory synthetic; shared constitutive physics; no plant validation
dataset_protocol.treatment: same raw observations and numerical characterization for all; executable old/new physical models only B/C
dataset_protocol.reference_post_capacity: completion and subsequent thermal outcomes censored; arbitrary reference pressure response
dataset_protocol.fit: two-channel soft_l1, scales .12 C and 1e-5 kg, bounds .6..1.8, initial 1/1, max_nfev16; no fit for pretransfer
dataset_protocol.applicability_policy: identical B/C: no valid completion after predicted overload or observed pressure discrepancy; invalid-domain fits prohibited
dataset_protocol.case_sampling: six deliberately balanced authored families; not manufacturing prevalence

agent_protocol.arm_difference: A no physical model; B legacy model; C improved model. Shared numerical tool and submission schema.
agent_protocol.order: Six arm permutations cycle across sorted cases, same order for both tasks; sequential arms within each case/task.
agent_protocol.system_prompt:
You are a manufacturing process research agent in a synthetic freeze-drying study.
Use only the public packet and tools available in this fresh session. Observations
are evidence; simulations are predictions with limitations. When completion_time_h
is null or applicability is invalid, diagnostic_completion_time_h is NOT a usable
completion forecast; never substitute that diagnostic for the censored forecast. Unknown receiving
characterization and model mismatch may matter. No real equipment action is authorized.
For BOTH forecast and pretransfer tasks, completion_time_h, thermal_warning and
capacity_warning MUST describe the KEEP schedule, independently of your action_id.
The completion time is absolute elapsed hours from batch start, not remaining hours.
Warnings concern a thermal limit excursion and equipment vapor capacity exceedance
respectively. Use null when unable to assess. Separately select a justified allowed
action to reduce completion time subject to thermal and capacity constraints, or
characterize when the evidence does not justify committing a schedule. Describe
uncertainty and concrete evidence references. Never treat plans as observations.
You have at most 8 host tool calls INCLUDING submission and 8 model calls. Reserve
one tool call for submit_decision, then stop. No tool retrieves hidden answers.
This sensitivity allows 240 seconds and eight model calls. The final model call
exposes ONLY submit_decision and requires that submission. Reserve one of your
eight host tool calls for submission. Earlier submission is allowed. Numerical
analysis and physical-model outputs are still hypotheses, not validated truth.
agent_protocol.scope: Post-hoc motivated, prospectively frozen same-case subset; joint budget and submission-policy change; not independent confirmation
agent_protocol.completion_policy: Final eighth provider turn exposes only submit_decision with forced function choice, identically across all three arms; earlier submission allowed; eight host calls include submission
agent_protocol.selection_rule: Lexicographically smallest opaque case_id in each authored family; no outcomes used for selection
agent_protocol.motivation: Post-hoc observation that primary A sessions spend their four model turns building numerical analyses; primary failures retained
bundled_interventions: final provider turn has only submit_decision and forced function choice
agent_protocol.interpretation: Prospectively frozen execution of a post-hoc motivated sensitivity; not an untouched holdout or pure compute-budget causal estimate
agent_protocol.final_turn_policy: Shared by A/B/C: eighth provider request exposes and requires only submit_decision; all earlier tool availability unchanged

metric_definitions.mean_throughput_vials_h: Benchmark throughput score over planned cases: synthetic feasible vials/hour, zero for invalid selections, characterize, execution failures and missing attempts; not real plant throughput.
metric_definitions.warning_truth_support: Positive, negative and unknown reference outcomes among all planned KEEP cases. Sensitivity cannot be estimated with no positives.

cost.basis: Whole campaign proxy ledger, including any preflight or interrupted requests: sum of settled conservative_cost_usd from provider token counts at recorded list rates, not an invoice. Unsettled or abandoned reservations remain unknown spending; total_reserved_usd is the admission accounting amount, not actual charges.

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive; authored families are not manufacturing prevalence
